page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel processing, AI inference, and compute-intensive tasks. Powered by the x86_64 CPU architecture on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance.

The hardware configuration includes two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. Network communication is handled via a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. The instance contains no local disk storage, requiring persistent data to be managed via remote block storage services.

In terms of resource density, the instance pairs substantial host CPU and memory resources with lightweight GPU acceleration. This profile provides qualitative efficiency for workloads needing GPU acceleration alongside high CPU core counts without requiring top-tier enterprise training accelerators. Tradeoffs include reliance on external storage for persistent data and the generation profile of the NVIDIA P4 architecture.
The instance is suited for deep learning inference, video transcoding, image processing pipelines, and general compute workloads that benefit from dedicated core counts and hardware acceleration.
